Use case: precise-object-edit. Production asset: a clean EMPTY tropical resort background plate for a fixed side-view 2D volleyball game, landscape 1600x1000 (8:5).
Use the attached reference as the visual source: preserve its realistic sumptuous tropical architecture, curved white resort hotel on the right cliff, cascading waterfalls, palms, blue sky with puffy clouds, distant green island on left and vivid turquoise sea with a few distant sailboats, lush succulent edges and pale warm finely textured sand. Sunny midday physically realistic contemporary 3D game environment, vibrant but natural color, high detail.
REMOVE ALL gameplay objects completely: both human players, ball, net and center post, robot bee and cocktail, floating magnet robot, all HUD, all score numbers/icons. REMOVE the close foreground side-wall pillars/service doors and buttons, leave open beach edges. No humans in the picture, no character ghosts, no net ghost, no service robots, no game text.
IMPORTANT GAME ALIGNMENT: recompose the environment for an 8:5 side-view game stage. The perfectly horizontal back edge of the foreground playable sand plane must be at 94% image height (y=940 in a 1000 high image), with sandy foreground continuing to the bottom. Ocean water must NEVER cross below this flat ground line. Above this line, include a narrow distant shoreline and plenty of calm turquoise water. Horizon around 65% image height, mountains and resort behind. The upper 25% should be mostly blue sky, palms in corners, uncluttered for an existing HUD. Architecture stays far behind the gameplay plane. The hotel and cliffs can be scenic but keep lower central water region visually calm for very small game characters. Realistic direct light and coherent environment perspective. Avoid foreground props that obstruct the playing plane.
On one small hotel sign in upper right use exact text "LAST CHANCE", understated, not a title overlay. Output only the clean environment background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: production game texture atlas, square 1024x1024 PNG.
Image 1 is the EXACT geometry/UV template. Image 2 is a character appearance/style reference only.
Render photorealistic human body-part textures INTO the existing 13 tan silhouettes of Image 1, without moving, rotating, resizing, rearranging or adding any silhouette. Keep the same flat light gray background. Each 256x256 cell is independent and source pixels must stay aligned to this template. No full-body character anywhere. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no watermark. Perfect orthographic frontal cutout lighting: realistic warm tan skin, anatomical soft highlights and shadows, skin pores, subtle fabric texture. Bright sunlight from upper left with soft fill, natural realistic game asset quality. Human flesh anatomical forms, not plastic mannequin or cartoon.
Read template strictly in row-major order of a 4x4 grid:
row1 col1 head inside round silhouette, head fills the circle edge-to-edge hair on top and face chin on bottom, no neck below; row1 col2 front torso with neck at top and abdomen at bottom; row1 col3 pelvic/shorts region front view; row1 col4 horizontal UPPER ARM with shoulder on RIGHT and elbow on LEFT.
row2 col1 horizontal UPPER ARM with shoulder on LEFT and elbow on RIGHT; row2 col2 horizontal FOREARM with elbow RIGHT and wrist LEFT; row2 col3 horizontal FOREARM with elbow LEFT and wrist RIGHT; row2 col4 open HAND with wrist RIGHT and fingers pointing LEFT.
row3 col1 open HAND with wrist LEFT and fingers pointing RIGHT; row3 col2 vertical THIGH with hip TOP and knee BOTTOM; row3 col3 vertical THIGH with hip TOP and knee BOTTOM; row3 col4 vertical SHIN plus BARE FOOT from knee TOP to sole BOTTOM, toes point LEFT.
row4 col1 vertical SHIN plus BARE FOOT from knee TOP to sole BOTTOM, toes point RIGHT. The last three cells remain completely empty light gray.
Preserve the exact silhouette contour and attachment shape in every cell; these parts attach in a live ragdoll game and cannot change topology. Skin should slightly overfill template edges (about 4 pixels) to support clipping. Rounded skin at joint ends, no black cut-off cap or seam, no bones, no gore. Clothing begins at same height in both thighs, top 40% only, the remaining thighs are bare. Matching fabric and skin color at all joints.
CHARACTER: the reference's left adult male tourist, fit lean sun-tanned body, dark tousled brown hair with a turquoise headband, clean-shaven friendly realistic face turned slightly toward viewer RIGHT, no sunglasses. Head remains a round sprite to match guide, natural face. Bare chest and abdomen, NO jersey or sleeve. Teal/turquoise swim shorts with white tropical palm-leaf print, waistband in pelvic silhouette and shorts leg hems continuing across TOP 40% of both thighs, bare skin below. Upper arms completely bare; both forearms have thin turquoise-and-white wristbands near their WRIST ends. Bare feet. Exactly the colors and attractive realistic summer resort style of reference left man; use only his visual appearance, do not reproduce his pose.
